summary: Iteration 89 retest at 390x844 on web preview, plus the backend hygiene test. Of the 12 requested items, 10 pass. CRM chips are now visible and tappable. Saved search Run now applies its filters (Rent segment selected, beds badge shown) and the caption changes to 'Last ran …'. Representations show placeholder thumbnails with no ERR_INVALID_URL. Wallet shows the daily bonus as Claimed. Earn shows Verify phone as Done. SOCIAL_POST_COMMENT and SOCIAL_POST_LIKE notifications both open /social/post/<id>. Request Inspection opened directly by URL has the phone pre-filled. The Declutter bottom bar shows the icon chat button, Call and WhatsApp with full labels. FIXA WhatsApp buttons are not clipped (17 rows, no Bolu/Half Done duplicates). Admin flag titles read well ('AI valuation narrative', On/Off). The smoke test passed with zero console errors: UI login, map with pins, Feeds, Market, My Home, My Amass and Inbox all load. test_data_hygiene_iter88.py passed 4/4. NEW or remaining issues: (1) the CRM 'New' filter returns 0 leads even though Open contains a lead with the New badge; (2) demo /agent/representations holds 200 orphan PENDING 'duplex · agent mandate' reps created today by test_phase6c_passport_reps.py, and the screen reads '168 need your action'; (3) demo CRM holds 59 seeded test leads ('AMASS Buyer' / 'Property', property_id null) from test_phase4_reviews_score_crm.py; (4) legacy Neighbours notifications are still shown in /notifications and in Feeds Activity ('New resident request · Lekki Gardens Phase 2', 'Sharing Friend wants to connect', 'Electrical · Lekki Gardens Phase 2'), and tapping them does nothing.
